headline: Product Designer
tagline: Product designer with a CS background, focused on clean interfaces, user flows, and developer handoff.

skills.label: Product & UI/UX
skills.items: Figma, wireframing, prototyping, user flows, usability testing, responsive design, design systems

skills.label: Visual & Brand
skills.items: Typography, color theory, layout, visual hierarchy, Photoshop, Illustrator

skills.label: Technical & Workflow
skills.items: Developer handoff, technical feasibility, AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly)

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Delivered 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, and onboarding.
Worked with HR and management stakeholders to maintain low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready file requirements including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.
Used AI-assisted workflows like ChatGPT and Adobe Firefly for ideation.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Conducted usability testing, feeding findings back into user flows and interface usability.
Created wireframes and prototypes for early-stage digital products.
Worked closely with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.
Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for startups and SMBs.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator for product visuals and marketing assets.

projects.name: Bounceless
bullets: Designed a B2B UX case study focused on a cleaner verification experience for teams depending on accurate email lists.

projects.name: Fashion Brand Social Campaign
bullets: Designed Instagram and fashion brand series that contributed to a 15% increase in follower engagement.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)
education.detail: B.Tech in Computer Science (CGPA 8.03). Provides strong foundations for developer handoff, technical feasibility, and systems thinking.

emphasis: Led with AT Creation's UX process and the Bounceless case study to match the product design requirement, while highlighting her B.Tech Computer Science degree as a differentiator for developer handoff.
